name: GB/T 20234.3 DC
description: Chinese national DC charging coupler defined by GB/T 20234.3, rated up to 1500 V DC and 800 A since the 2023 edition (1000 V and 250 A in the 2015 edition). Nine contacts: DC+, DC−, protective earth, CAN charging communication (S+, S−), two charging connection confirmation contacts (CC1, CC2) and a low-voltage auxiliary supply (A+, A−). The vehicle inlet carries contact tubes and the vehicle connector carries pins.

electricalProfiles.name: DC
conditions: Upper limits of the scope of GB/T 20234.3-2023: rated voltage up to 1500 V DC, rated current (maximum continuous operating current) up to 800 A. The Table 1 rating steps of the 2023 edition were not reviewed.
GB/T 20234.3-2015 (superseded) covered couplers up to 1000 V DC and 250 A, with DC+/DC− rated 750 V or 1000 V and 80, 125, 200 or 250 A.
In the 2015 edition, S+, S−, CC1 and CC2 are rated 0 to 30 V, 2 A, and the auxiliary supply A+/A− 0 to 30 V, 20 A.
Under active cooling the maximum continuous current can exceed the table values (2023 edition, notes to Table 1).
Mating sequence (2023 edition): PE first, then CC2, DC±, A±, S± and CC1 last.
S+/S− carry the CAN charging communication (CAN_H, CAN_L).
CC1 and CC2 are charging connection confirmation contacts, recorded as proximity_pilot, the closest function in the OpenPlugDB vocabulary.
A+/A− (low-voltage auxiliary supply from the charger) have no function in the OpenPlugDB vocabulary and are left out of contactFunctions.

notes: Table 1 (rating steps) and Table 2 (contact ratings) of the 2023 edition were not reviewed; contact ratings in the conditions come from the 2015 edition.
Conflict: Wikipedia gives the auxiliary supply A+/A− as 12 V, 10 A, while GB/T 20234.3-2015 Table 2 gives 0 to 30 V, 20 A. The standard value is kept.

Contact genders (male vehicle connector, female vehicle inlet) rest on Wikipedia and on the 2023 foreword, which mentions the CC2 contact sleeve of the vehicle inlet; the Chinese original text was not checked.
The inlet face drawing relies on a single manufacturer source (Phoenix Contact 1271833, a 2015-edition product). The vehicle connector face is not drawn: no source depicting it was reviewed.
GB/T 20234.4-2023 (high-power DC coupler, ChaoJi) is a separate interface, not modelled yet.
The OpenStreetMap socket key for GB/T DC could not be checked against the pinned wiki revision; the mapping is left empty pending that check, not because no key exists.
The CC1/CC2 resistor coding and the control guidance circuit (GB/T 18487.1) are not recorded.
The EVicons plug-gbt-dc icon (0.8.0) is not attached: its outline has a flat top edge, while the inlet face recorded here (keying and front view) has none; the contact layout matches.
